metadata.title: Meta’s AI spending spree has investors taking a page from the financial-crisis playbook - MarketWatch

content.text:
Market Extra
Meta’s AI spending spree has investors taking a page from the financial-crisis playbook
The next hot AI play could be adding default protection
The hot new artificial-intelligence play might be adding default protection as investors anxiously await Meta to kick off earnings for the big “hyperscalers” of the artificial-intelligence race.
Hyperscalers and their spending plans used to set the tone for corporate earnings season, with stocks rallying on a “more is better” view. But that was before billions of dollars in debt was issued by the biggest AI players — before market indigestion and cracks began to appear in funding structures of CoreWeave and other riskier parts of the boom.
